canonical_storage_estimate: Exact UTF-8 length of the proposed v3 media descriptor in milestone-7-compression-protocol.md, including strict base64 payload and descriptor fields. It excludes the identical enclosing block/certificate/transaction fields, so it is an estimate of media-object storage rather than a measured complete block.
